params.prompt: Candid UGC iPhone photo of a real American woman in her mid-40s, slim-to-average build, dirty blonde hair in a low ponytail, wearing a fitted coral pink athletic tank top and dark gray leggings, sitting on a beige tufted sofa in her bright living room.
